title: Human Need and Resource Network Contract v1
description: A need-rooted production network. Resource richness is observed by resource, geography and time; carriers such as companies or securities are downstream mappings only.

event_time.description: When the model decision or real-world event occurred.

available_time.description: Earliest time the row is available to the local model.

observation_time.description: When a resource endowment was measured; it is not interchangeable with available_time.

candidate_needs_evidence.description: Candidate dependency only; cannot be used as a verified fact.

not_yet_observed.description: Missing quantity or accessibility is unknown, never zero.

carrier_mapping.description: A company or security can map to a process but cannot create a root need or dependency fact.
